race.comment: The maiden stayers kick us off. LOTTERY LINK (5) just ran into one better over this track and trip last time out and looks to be working up to a maiden victory. Gun hoop Rodd sticks in the irons and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Can finally shed the maiden tag against this line-up. SIR ARROGONCE (11) was in the betting when facing the starter for the first time and wasn't disgraced beaten only two lengths in town. Will have derived a stack of benefit from that day at the races and can feature with natural improvement. MAREMOTO (10) brings NSW formlines to the table and any market confidence must be noted. KONIGSTEIN (14) has been not far away in both runs so far, despite finishing tenth over 1350m at Doomben last time out. Can fill a place here.
